name: Memory Keeper
author: ShadowOne
description: For laptops that only ever sleep: stops Claude Code sessions left idle (resume them with a click), frees cold cache under real memory pressure, and shows what is holding your memory.

barWidget.description: Shows available memory and opens a panel with Claude sessions, what uses memory, and leftovers.

schema.label: Text beside the icon
schema.description: Available memory (13G), percent in use (56%), or icon only.
